description: This file implements an Auth0 Single Sign-On (SSO) integration class, extending a base SSO class, configuring passport strategies, handling login, callback, and token refresh processes, and providing a test setup method.

classes.name: Auth0SSO
classes.description: A class managing Auth0 SSO authentication, including configuration, login flow, callback handling, token refresh, and setup testing.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the provider name for this SSO, 'Auth0 SSO'.

methods.name: getCallbackURL
methods.description: Constructs and returns the callback URL for Auth0.

methods.name: setSSOConfig
methods.description: Sets the SSO configuration, configures passport with Auth0 strategy, and handles missing config.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes login and callback routes for Auth0 SSO.

methods.name: testSetup
methods.description: Tests the Auth0 configuration by requesting an OAuth token.

methods.name: refreshToken
methods.description: Refreshes the access token using a refresh token.
